title: Chapter 564
paragraphs: Chapter 564
Episode 147. The Black Sea King, Gleyack (8)
-"Secure Jin Runcandel, he must not be devoured by the chaos!"
Not long after Gleyack awoke, Kelliark cried out with such an urgent voice.
And from that, Jin was able to realize.
'Even though there is a method of resurrection through the Demon Stone, Kelliark showed unprecedented fluster the moment Gleyack awakened.'
This meant only one thing.
Even though he didn't know about other forms of death, if he lost his life by Gleyack, it would cause a fatal hitch in the completion of the Demon Stone.
'Thus, what Kelliark is most wary of is me dying or causing problems due to Gleyack.'
There was also something he could feel from Gleyack's grudge.
It wasn't just trying to 'kill' him. Like he devoured Dante, Gleyack was also trying to absorb him.
"If I am taken by Gleyack, Zipple cannot complete the Demon Stone."
Jin drove home the point.
Kelliark didn't deny his words.
The one who provided Jin with the clue was none other than himself, and it was a clear mistake.
"In my view, even if you reject my proposal, you would never carry out that threat. More precisely, you couldn't."
"Is that so?"

"You're too human, and you carry too much. There are many who risked their lives to save you, and what about your actions to save Highran? Throwing your life away just to block my obvious plan, it's something that can never happen. Too much bluff."
This time, Kelliark cut off Jin's response and added his own. Looking at Rosa.
"But your mother is not."
Rosa had been listening to their conversation.
"The moment I reject that proposal, your mother will immediately throw you into Gleyack's mouth. Is that not right? Rosa Runcandel."
Rosa gave a cold smile.
Accurate and correct.
Rosa assessed Jin's judgment like that. If Jin had said anything else, she would have made the same proposal to Kelliark herself.
The moment he tries to do something pointless, Jin's life is forfeit.
And as Kelliark said, it was not a bluff or a gamble, but a real threat.
She also read his weakness through his words that Jin must not be 'devoured by the chaos', and was also considering how he would proceed.
That's why she's still not using her full strength.
"I know well, Kelliark Zipple. So if you want to continue to hope for the completion of the Demon Stone, it's best not to resort to petty tricks."
The proposal Jin threw at Kelliark was another reason why Rosa had rejected the opinions of Myu and Anne all at once.
She still had a means to shake Kelliark's leash by taking Jin as a hostage.
"Having a weakness is a tiresome thing."
"We've lived like that for a thousand years, so there's no need to be too aggrieved."
Kelliark shrugged his shoulders.
"I accept the proposal. A temporary alliance."
"12th Knight, what kind of negotiation do you suggest with Kinzelo?"
In the front, Ron and Talaris, knights and magicians were attacking Gleyack.
Talaris still couldn't start the absolute sealing ritual of the maze in earnest.
Jin locked eyes with Rosa.

"Given the circumstances, they likely knew the identity of the white stone from the start, and there is a high possibility that they had a means to restrain Gleyack. Whether it's the power of Genesis, or something else. And what they seem to want is for everyone gathered here to exchange blows with each other, and Gleyack, resulting in irreversible damage."
Jin pointed behind him.
It was where the knights of Runcandel rescued the Vamel Alliance and escaped.
"They will ask to step in and solve Gleyack now. If those bastards don't participate in this battle, we'll immediately escape from here and go to their base."
If Kinzelo doesn't agree to solve Gleyack, they'll hit Kinzelo, even if they have to give up the last line of defense of the world.
That was what Jin was saying.
'Choose to join us in stopping this or we all die. An ultimatum.'
Kinzelo wants a reduction of forces, not the end of the world.
Whether they have the power of Genesis as a means to stop the King of the Black Sea, or they have some other plan.
They may not be able to wage war and win against all of those fighting Gleyack right now.
The strongest power Jin has seen from Kinzelo so far was the Commander and Zephyrin.
But the Commander is not fully recovered and Zephyrin, who operates based on his power, is also not able to fully exert his strength.
Of course, apart from them, there are the ship Gurnil and Berakt, the beast warriors, the living golem known as Myungin, and the demons that recently revealed themselves in the Sota Desert.
Among them, there were those like Bianca Caligo who demonstrated first-class superhuman strength.
There may be more unrevealed powers, but they certainly wouldn't be able to withstand a combined attack from Runcandel and Zipple right now.
If they could, the hegemony of the world would have already been in Kinzelo's hands long ago.
Rosa was very pleased with Jin's plan.
The irresistible proposal to Kelliark with his life as collateral, and the categorical demand to Kinzelo to step up right away even if it meant the destruction of their family and world.
All perfectly matched Rosa's thoughts.
"The plan is roughly set."
Rosa's sword was dyed in radiant light. Her exploding energy, like an active volcano, started to form another whirlwind on the battlefield.
Vroom...! Kelliark's Huroti began to emit energy, producing a gloomy resonance.
Despite Rosa single-handedly protecting her family's knights and opening a path, and Kelliark having been in battle for a long time, neither showed any signs of exhaustion.
If Gleyack was not the King of the Black Sea, but merely a demon with purely equivalent martial power.
If they didn't need the power of Genesis to kill him.
They would never have had to negotiate with Kinzelo at the risk of the world.
Now they had only one task. To assist Talaris in deploying the absolute seal of the maze and determine who will negotiate with Kinzelo.
However, even after the sealing ritual is over, Rosa, Kelliark, Ron, and Talaris cannot leave the battlefield.
Talaris needs to maintain the seal, and the others must hold their positions in case of emergencies.
Even if the seal is completed, there's no guarantee that Gleyack will stop all activities, and even the two days mentioned by Talaris is not certain.
Jin couldn't go either.
While he always managed to get favorable results against Kinzelo, sending Jin to Kinzelo's base now was no different from handing over a weakness.
The only reason Runcandel and Zipple could temporarily unite is Jin's life.
If Kinzelo captures Jin, Zipple will have to negotiate with them, not Runcandel. If that happens, Runcandel would obviously be finished.
"Sir Stamm!"
Stamm broke from the ranks and stood in front of Rosa.
"Give me your command."
Rosa succinctly explained to him the results derived with Jin and Kelliark.
"Notify the Lord of the Maze about the matter, and you go directly to negotiate with Kinzelo."
"Understood."
"Octavia!"
This time, Octavia approached Kelliark.
"Go negotiate with Kinzelo along with the Black Knight Captain of Runcandel."
"Understood, Lord."
And so, it was decided that Stamm and Octavia, the two of them, would go to Kinzelo's headquarters.
Stamm then relayed the plan to Talaris.
Talaris showed a displeased expression because the negotiation plan with Kinzelo could diverge from the maze's mission of 'guarding the world from anomalies.'
If Kinzelo rejects the negotiations, and indeed the forces of Runcandel and Zipple direct their power not at Gleyack but at their headquarters, the world's destruction would be inevitable.
Then, Talaris would have to fight Gleyack alone, or together with Ron.
However, Talaris had no choice but to accept the plans of the great powers. Since Chiron couldn't come, there was no other way.
'I... I might have to think about completely releasing the seal of Elona Zipple.'
If Kinzelo refuses the negotiations and things start to become irreversible.
In the end, Talaris would release the seal of Elona. Her power in the records definitely reaches Genesis, so she should be able to stand against Gleyack.
However, it was uncertain what would happen when she returned to the world.
-The maze has been hiding this woman from Zipple for a thousand years.
-If they discover her, you mean this woman can become active again.
-I don't want to imagine that future. If such a monster is added to Zipple, which is already monopolizing, there would no longer be a balance.
The conversation Talaris had with Jin when she first told him about the mission of the maze.
As she said, Elona would stand on Zipple's side even if she stopped Gleyack... It was impossible to know whether this would be a better result than Gleyack corroding the world.
'Either way, the moment Kinzelo refuses the proposal, there is no answer. It means I'm useless as a maze lord.'
Whooosh-!
A gust of wind began to spread on the battlefield.
"I will start the absolute seal!"
As Talaris retreated to the rear and took her position, she shouted. Manbing was rising in front of her.
At the same time, Rosa and Kelliark threw themselves towards Gleyack, and Stamm and Octavia stood on either side of Talaris, spreading a protective barrier.
Jin stepped into the middle, watching the backs of the battling giants.
Despite the onslaught of Ron's stormy ashen sword energy, Kelliark's magic, and Rosa's final energies, Gleyack showed slight hesitation, but he was smiling.
As if he knew all of their plans.
